mentions.name: WriteNow
mentions.description: This online counseling platform provides remote therapy sessions focused on affordability ($25/week) and accessibility, while prioritizing fair treatment of both clients and therapists. It is bootstrapped and currently available in NY, FL, TX and Singapore, with plans to expand as budget allows.
mentions.problem: Traditional counseling can be expensive and inaccessible for many people.
mentions.audience: People seeking affordable counseling (clients) as well as the therapists who serve them.
mentions.source_excerpt: Completely bootstrapped online counseling platform focused on affordability ($25/week!), accessibility and doing the right thing by clients and therapists. Currently only available in NY, FL, TX and Singapore with plans to expand as budget allows.

evidence.value: Completely bootstrapped online counseling platform focused on affordability ($25/week!), accessibility and doing the right thing by clients and therapists. Currently only available in NY, FL, TX and Singapore with plans to expand as budget allows.
